issues: As of 2026-11-14 the school's Academics page shows a 'Program of Studies (Coming Soon!)' button with an empty link; no current or older EFMHS program of studies was found on the school site, the FNESU site, the FNESU Academics/Curriculum Google Site, or via web search. The FNESU curriculum site links a Richford High School Program of Studies only (same SU, different school) — do not use for Enosburg. Graduation requirements are described as FNESU proficiency-based 'Portrait of a Learner' requirements (9th-grade page links the Portrait of a Learner page; it explains the model but is not a credit table). School Profile on Google Drive requires sign-in. The school's former domain ehornets.org no longer resolves; Wayback Machine was unreachable from this environment so older archived catalogs were not checked. Worth re-checking later or asking the counseling office.
